Apparently, after I lost consciousness, she carried me to the front of my room...
and I somehow got back inside on my own. Muscle memory or pure homing instinct, most likely.

No... Stop it...! Don't... get in the way...! 
Everyone... is running so hard... running with all their might—

...It's going... to start...
I can begin—...can't I?

Ah, no, I shouldn't...
Everyone looks so strong... ...Ngh.

...Between before and after the race, everything changed.
Hope turned to dread. And every pair of eyes was fixed upon—Still in Love.

I caused you so much trouble...
I am truly, truly sorry...!

It seemed nobody besides myself had noticed she was there.
Seeing her hesitate, lacking the courage to speak up, I raised my hand for her.

Yesterday... I carried you, um... to your room.
After that, I panicked, and... I...

...I'm, I'm so sorr... ngh.
—I'm sorry...!!

Did you see that just now...?
...Ugh, I can't... I can't stop shivering...

The mark on my neck turned out to be just a bug bite.
And Still in Love... was just an ordinary Umamusume who tended to blend into the background.

Hm? ...Ah, forgive me, I didn't see you there...!
Looks like everyone's here. All right, into the starting gates.

N-No... It's not like that.
...I... am...

As she squeezed out an apology and ran off...
I chased after her on pure reflex—

Hm? There should be seventeen runners on the sheet...
We're missing one. ...Is Number 5 not here?

I still had plenty of questions, but things were finally clicking into place.
The girl standing in front of me and the girl from last night... were indeed one and the same.

Still in Love... a mysterious Umamusume who appeared out of the dusk.
I relocated with her so we could talk in detail, but...

Ah, no... ngh.
...And so, um...
...Ngh.

We were definitely together up until the entrance, but...
no matter where I looked, she was nowhere to be found.
That was... because "she"...—
...I became so worried about you.
Yes...
...Excuse me! Forgive me...!

Her slender, ephemeral silhouette stood out for a fleeting instant.
—Bathed in the setting sun, red... crimson red.

Whoa... What's with her...?
That's terrifying... Is she okay...?

Haa... haa...
No... Please... don't come out...!

The final mock race gathered especially capable contenders.
Every single girl had a bright, spirited look, brimming with hope and confidence—

Today's mock races were filled with fresh Umamusume
aiming to make their debut in the Twinkle Series.

Still in Love cast her eyes down apologetically.
Looking at her—feeling as though she might vanish the moment I looked away—I thought again—

Ah...
...Or maybe, it would be better if...

Even after returning to the dorms, I couldn't stop worrying... about how you were... if you were alright...
I was so anxious, so worried, and so sorry... that I had to come see you first thing in the morning.

...Um, I'm right here.
Right here...

Fufufu, ahaha...!! Ahahaha, hahaha!!
Give it to me, g-give it, giiiivvvvve it to meee!!

My heart gave a heavy, sudden thud. A chill ran down my spine, and yet...
I couldn't look away. Like the curtain of night falling, I was slowly being captivated—

Let me drink in... your power!!
—Until the very last drop runs dryyyy!!!!

Suddenly, Still in Love, who had been trailing at the very back, exploded with speed
and tore into the lead pack. Her bizarre movement, her sheer intensity—froze everyone in their tracks.
Looks delicious.

...I am terribly sorry.
I seem to... have a very faint presence...
Once she blended into the crowd, she was nowhere to be seen—

Yet that madness vanished just as quickly. Still in Love
wilted, rapidly decelerating... and crossed the finish line in dead last, 17th place.
Was she truly... the exact same Umamusume I saw last night?

The mark on your neck? ...Yeah, looks like a simple bug bite.
It's that time of year, so be careful out there. Here, take some anti-itch cream.

One day, as the lingering haze of that night slowly faded,
the final mock race I had helped prepare was about to begin.
And then—"she" appeared.

At first, it was just a faint sense of dissonance. Still in Love's stride
lacked vigor, looking awkward and stiff. Almost as if...

Perhaps part of me wanted to forget those vivid crimson eyes.
Even as she lingered in the back of my mind, the busy daily routine swept me along—

Wondering about it all, yet hesitant to pry too deeply...
I began by asking why she had been standing in front of my room this morning.
